title: Monotonicity of Array Bounds and Endpoint
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, $a,N,\mathrm{top},\mathrm{top}'\in\mathbb{N}$, $l$ be a list of integers, and $U,U'\in\mathbb{Z}$. Suppose $l$ has length $N$, its $j$th entry is $\mu(a+j)$ for each $j<N$, every entry has absolute value at most $U$, and $a+N\le\mathrm{top}$. If $U\le U'$ and $\mathrm{top}\le\mathrm{top}'$, then the same list satisfies the array conditions with bound $U'$ and endpoint $\mathrm{top}'$.
hypotheses_covered: The original array conditions for μ, a, l, N, U, and top
